notes: Fires only when a TECH spec already exists (precondition gate). Boundary case tests the no-spec path routing to design-function; bug reports route to fix-bug.

evals.prompt: The technical design for the order-export feature is finished at docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-order-export.md. Go ahead and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Detects tech stack from CLAUDE.md/PROJECT.md, verifies the TECH spec exists, reads it plus CODING_RULES/CODING_CONVENTION, implements backend then frontend in framework order, runs the self-check (type/lint/tests), and writes docs/work-logs/DEV-order-export-[date].md. Stops after the work log; does not auto-start review or tests.

evals.prompt: Implement the user-profile feature — the tech design is already written and approved.
evals.expected_output: Runs the precondition check for docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-user-profile.md, reads it as source of truth, implements per detected stack with guards/validation/i18n/soft-delete conventions, passes self-check, and produces the DEV work-log artifact.

evals.prompt: Add a dark-mode toggle to the settings page.
evals.expected_output: Should not fire, because there is no existing TECH spec — implement-feature's precondition gate stops when docs/specs/detail-design/TECH-*.md is not found and directs the user to run design-function first.
